description: Iraqi Air Force Pilatus PC-9, construction number 148, preserved on a landscaped mound near the entrance to the Iraqi air force enclave at Baghdad International Airport, the former New Al Muthana air base. Spottingmode record refreshed 9 June 2022; Esri imagery of 8 April 2025 shows a small light aircraft-shaped object on the mound at the point.
museum_name: New Al Muthana Air Base Baghdad
